title: Deepavali Maha Lakshmi-Ganesh Puja
significance: Conducted on Kartik Amavasya during Pradosh Kaal / Nishita Kaal to welcome Goddess Lakshmi, Lord Ganesha and Kuber for eternal light and prosperity.

steps.title: Pavitrikaran (आत्मशुद्धि)
steps.mantra: ॐ अपवित्रः पवित्रो वा सर्वावस्थां गतोऽपि वा। यः स्मरेत्पुण्डरीकाक्षं स बाह्याभ्यन्तरः शुचिः॥
steps.instructions: Sprinkle Ganga Jal over yourself, the puja altar, and all samagri with kusha grass or flower.

steps.title: Achaman (आचमन)
steps.mantra: ॐ केशवाय नमः। ॐ नारायणाय नमः। ॐ माधवाय नमः। ॐ हृषीकेशाय नमः।
steps.instructions: Take a spoonful of pure water in right palm, sip three times uttering holy names of Vishnu, then wash hands.

steps.title: Deepa Prajwalan & Sankalp (संकल्प)
steps.mantra: मम सकलदुरितोपशमनपूर्वक धनधान्य-समृद्धि-प्राप्त्यर्थं श्री महालक्ष्मी-गणेश प्रीत्यर्थं पूजनं करिष्ये।
steps.instructions: Light the master Ghee Akhand Diya. Take Akshat, water, flower and coin in hand and state family name and gotra.

steps.title: Ganesh Sthapana & Shodashopachara
steps.mantra: ॐ गणानां त्वा गणपतिं हवामहे प्रियाणां त्वा प्रियपतिं हवामहे निधीनां त्वा निधिपतिं हवामहे वसो मम।
steps.instructions: Bathe Ganesha with Panchamrit then Ganga Jal, apply chandan, offer Janeu, Durva grass, and Modak.

steps.title: Maha Lakshmi Avahana & Pujan
steps.mantra: ॐ श्रीं ह्रीं क्लीं त्रिभुवन महालक्ष्म्यै अस्मांक दारिद्र्य नाशय प्रसीद प्रसीद हीं क्लीं श्रीं ॐ।
steps.instructions: Offer lotus flower, red vastra, Shringar samagri, Kheel Batashe, and light 11 Ghee diyas around the altar.

steps.title: Aarti & Kshama Prarthana
steps.mantra: ॐ जय लक्ष्मी माता... आवाहनं न जानामि न जानामि विसर्जनम्। पूजां चैव न जानामि क्षमस्व परमेश्वरि॥
steps.instructions: Sing Maha Lakshmi & Ganesh Aarti standing. Seek forgiveness for any ritual shortcomings with folded hands.

title: Maha Shivratri 4-Prahar Rudrabhishek
significance: Observed on Phalguna Krishna Chaturdashi. Night-long four prahar worship of Lord Shiva granting salvation and destruction of all accumulated sins.

samagri.item: Pure Cow Milk, Curd, Ghee, Honey & Sugar

steps.title: Dhyanam & Avahanam
steps.mantra: ध्यायेन्नित्यं महेशं रजतगिरिनिभं चारुचन्द्रावतंसं रत्नाकल्पोज्ज्वलाङ्गं परशुमृगवराभीतिहस्तं प्रसन्नम्।
steps.instructions: Meditate upon Bhagwan Bholenath seated atop Mount Kailash with crescent moon adorning His locks.

steps.title: Panchamrit Abhishek
steps.mantra: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्। उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात्॥
steps.instructions: Pour milk, curd, ghee, honey, and sugarcane juice over the Shiva Lingam continuously while chanting Mahamrityunjaya.

steps.title: Belpatra Samarpana
steps.mantra: त्रिदलं त्रिगुणाकारं त्रिनेत्रं च त्रियायुधम्। त्रिजन्मपापसंहारं बिल्वपत्रं शिवार्पणम्॥
steps.instructions: Offer sacred 3-leaf Belpatra with smooth side facing Lingam, chanting Bilvashtakam.

steps.title: Bhasma & Shringar
steps.instructions: Apply sacred Tripundra bhasma, offer Dhatura, Janeu, white flowers and perform Karpura Aarti.

title: Shri Satyanarayan Vrat Katha & Vidhi
hindiTitle: श्री सत्यनारायण व्रत कथा एवं विधि
significance: Observed on Purnima, Thursdays, or major family milestones to bring truth, harmony, wealth, and fulfillment of deep wishes.

steps.title: Kalash Sthapana & Navagraha Pujan
steps.mantra: ॐ कलशस्य मुखे विष्णुः कण्ठे रुद्रः समाश्रितः। मूले तत्र स्थितो ब्रह्मा मध्ये मातृगणाः स्मृताः॥
steps.instructions: Establish water-filled copper Kalash with mango leaves and coconut wrapped in red cloth.

steps.title: Satyanarayan Avahana
steps.instructions: Place Shaligram or Vishnu Murti on yellow cloth and offer Panchamrit, Chandan, and Tulsi leaves.

steps.title: 5 Adhyaya Vrat Katha Shravan
steps.instructions: Recite or listen to the five divine chapters with family seated in silence.

steps.title: Panjiri Prasad Vitaran & Aarti
steps.instructions: Offer Panjiri, Charanamrit and distribute prasad to all family members.
